links.outcome: Readability of LLM-generated geriatric patient information (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level, Flesch Reading Ease)
links.effect: Median Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level 8.3 (IQR 7.4-9.6); median Flesch Reading Ease 60.8 (IQR 50.1-66.9); described as generally accessible language.
links.quote: Readability analysis indicated generally accessible language, with a median Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level of 8.3 (IQR 7.4-9.6) and a median Flesch Reading Ease score of 60.8 (IQR 50.1-66.9).

screen.reason: Expert evaluation of LLM-generated patient education materials for geriatric conditions without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
